name: shader-lens-blur

frames.best_why: The pointer is over the shape, so the lens blur and green colour shift are at their strongest.

tagline: A soft gradient triangle blurs and inverts around the cursor.
summary: A WebGL shader that draws a large rounded triangle filled with drifting pastel colour, blurring and inverting near the pointer and following touch.
appearance: A big triangle with gently rounded corners glows in a mint-to-blue-to-pink gradient on a black panel. Its edges are soft, and small grey instructions sit at the bottom left.
behaviour: The four-colour gradient drifts continuously; moving the pointer across the shape blurs and colour-inverts the area around it, and dragging on touch does the same.
demo_content: Caption Inverted mouse interaction using mouse or touch at the bottom left.
search_phrases: webgl triangle with blur around cursor
gradient blob that reacts to mouse
interactive shader shape for a hero
use_when: A hero or feature panel needs a single bold shape with an interactive, tactile surface.
avoid_when: It is a fixed 400px-tall WebGL canvas and needs three and jotai, with no reduced-motion path.
customise: All options live in an external jotai config atom (variation, four colours, hover, size); the component itself takes no props.
weight_why: A three.js WebGL scene renders the shader every animation frame.

a11y.note: The canvas has no accessible name or fallback text, and the interaction is pointer-only with no reduced-motion branch.

issues: No reduced-motion handling; the shader runs every frame regardless.
Interaction is pointer and touch only, so keyboard users cannot affect it.
The canvas gives screen readers nothing to describe.
polish_why: Soft gradient and a convincing lens blur; limited to one shape and missing a11y.
